verdicts.flaw_description: A site-wide discount cutting prices by a fifth ran through every segment's post-switch month, and the report explicitly notes every segment browsed the general catalogue, so the discount reached all four cases; a 20 percent price cut is an obvious alternative cause of the 4-7 percent purchase lift.

The claim is about particulate readings, but every case reports backpressure (12, 9, 14 and 8 percent lower) — a measure of flow resistance across the filter, not of particulate emission; lower backpressure is if anything consistent with less filtration.

Corticosteroid injections at each hospital tripled from the earlier quarter and every intake was cleared to receive them, so a known ROM-improving co-treatment scaled up across all four intakes and fully explains the 9-16 degree abduction gains.

The claim is about germination, but each lot was scored on tetrazolium viability (9, 6, 11 and 7 points above the previous sowing) — a stain test of seed embryo viability performed on seed, not a measure of how many seeds actually germinated.
